name: Anhui Tongfeng Electronics Company Limited
summary: Anhui Tongfeng Electronics Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of film capacitors and related film materials in the People's Republic of China and internationally. It operates through Electronic-Grade Thin Film Materials, Capacitors, Crystal Devices, Recycled Resins, Connectors, and Others segments. The company offers polypropylene films, metallized films, AC capacitors, DC capacitors, power electronic capacitors, polyester films, capacitor accessories, and precision connectors; supporting equipment; and trading and technical services. Its products are used in new energy, rail transit, power transmission, ship propulsion…
